posts.alt: Rancho Santa Fe backyard outdoor kitchen with a Summerset grill and travertine counters at golden hour
posts.hook: Stone that matches the house. Steel that outlives the mortgage.
posts.caption:
An outdoor kitchen should read like part of the estate, not an appliance parked on the patio.

Travertine counters to echo the architecture, a full stainless cooking suite, and an island sized for the way this family actually entertains.

The selections:
• Summerset Sizzler Pro grill
• travertine counters
• natural-stone island
• cedar pergola
• mature olive trees

posts.alt: Modern San Diego backyard patio with a fire pit and string lights at dusk
posts.hook: The hour after sunset is the one you'll actually use.
posts.caption:
Most yards are designed for the photo at noon. We design for 8:45 on a weeknight.

A fire pit to hold the center, warm string lights overhead, and paving that glows under good landscape lighting. The yard doesn't end at sunset — that's when it starts.

The selections:
• linear fire pit
• Belgard pavers
• café string lights
• built-in seating
• olive & ornamental grasses

Want your yard to look like this after dark? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: North Park urban backyard with a pergola, fire pit, water bowl and porcelain pavers at dusk
posts.caption:

A water bowl for sound that covers the street, a slim fire pit for warmth, porcelain that stays cool underfoot, all under a pergola that makes the space feel like a room.

The selections:
• Belgard Porcelain pavers
• steel water bowl
• cedar pergola
• linear fire pit
• vertical garden

posts.alt: Stamped-concrete driveway with landscape lighting and drought-tolerant planting at a San Diego home at twilight
posts.hook: The same driveway looks twice the price after dark.
posts.caption:
Good lighting is the cheapest upgrade a front yard can get — and the most overlooked.

Stamped concrete with a stone border, raised planters to add depth, and low path lights that pick out the texture once the sun drops. The house looks composed all night.

The selections:
• stamped concrete with stone banding
• agave & aloe
• FX Luminaire path lighting
• raised planters
• decomposed-granite beds

Want curb appeal that works after dark? DM “DESIGN”.
